instagram.caption:
The duct you have not looked at.
The Washer and Dryer in the Laundry Room. Run loads reliably, and stay maintained well enough that the machines are never the reason laundry stops.

What done looks like:
1. Both drums empty with the washer door propped ajar
2. Nothing at all sitting on either lid
3. A clean lint screen back in its slot
4. A strip of masking tape on the side of the dryer with the month you last cleared the duct written on it

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success washer and dryer.
